newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Gencor wants to influence Brazil's CVRD.
newsitem.headline: Gencor wants to influence Brazil's CVRD.

text.p: South African mining company Gencor wants an influential stake in a consortium participating in the privatisation auction of Brazilian state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), a newspaper said.
The final tender details for the privatisation auction are due to be published this week and the sell-off of a 40-45 percent block of CVRD voting shares will probably take place in April.
Gencor Chairman Brian Gilbertson told Gazeta Mercantil newspaper his company wanted a stake of at least 10 percent in order to be able to influence the future management of CVRD.

Gilbertson declined to name the other members of the bidding consortium, but he said it would include a Brazilian company. He also said Gencor had been in negotiations with Brazil's pulp and paper firm Votorantim.
--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
